verdict.rationale: Loops documents an official CLI on its own page (/agents/cli). It manages contacts, sends events, triggers transactional email and tests integrations from the terminal. Every command supports JSON output for scripting and multi-team auth, and the CLI installs via curl, Homebrew, PowerShell or Go. It is explicitly paired with agent skills so coding agents can drive it. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as documented.
